caption: The drawing depicts an interior view of a room focused on a decorated fireplace set into an ornate wall. The fireplace is made of stone or marble, predominantly colored in light gray with detailed carvings on the mantel and surrounding structure. Above the fireplace, there is an elaborately framed rectangular portrait of a man in formal attire, with a dark coat and a white collar, set against a dark background. The wall around the fireplace is decorated with a wide strip of intricate molding and floral patterns in white, continuing horizontally above the fireplace and vertically as pilasters to either side. The walls on either side of the fireplace are covered in a light yellow or beige patterned wallpaper, with wooden panel wainscoting below in a muted mauve or light brown shade. The floor is colored to resemble wood in brown tones. The drawing is flanked on both the left and right edges by large vertical bands of solid black, as if the scene is being viewed through a narrow opening or from behind drapes.
title: Interior
